"""Repro for the Lag()/DecimalField SQLite crash (issue in TASK.md)."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth", "repro_app"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection, models  # noqa: E402


class LagTest(models.Model):
    modified = models.DateField()
    data = models.FloatField()
    amount = models.DecimalField(decimal_places=4, max_digits=7)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro_app"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(LagTest)

LagTest.objects.bulk_create(
    [
        LagTest(modified=f"2020-10-{d:02d}", data=1.5, amount="1.5000")
        for d in range(1, 11)
    ]
)

from django.db.models import F, Window  # noqa: E402
from django.db.models.functions import Lag  # noqa: E402

w = Window(
    expression=Lag("amount", 7),
    partition_by=[F("modified")],
    order_by=F("modified").asc(),
)
q = LagTest.objects.all().annotate(w=w)
print("SQL:", str(q.query))
rows = list(q)
print("OK: query executed, rows:", len(rows), "first w:", rows[0].w)
